page_note: Page is dominated by two parallel cosmological enumerations — the sun's seven goods (segs 0-12) and the night's seven evils (segs 23-36) — with the second wickedness sequence ending the page. A polemical excursus against 'the doctrine of the Errant' (segs 13-17) interrupts between the seventh good and the transition. Teacher voice resumes briefly at segs 18-20 to mark the pivot from sun to night, then substrate enumeration restarts. Editorial fatigue score is strongly negative — substrate vocabulary increases in second half, consistent with the polemic being a localized insertion rather than terminal drift.
